description: The CTIO filter collection comprises the observatory pool of optical narrow-band and broad-band interference filters made available for instrumentation across CTIO telescopes.
facility_description: Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) is an astronomical observatory located on Cerro Tololo in Chile, operated by NSF NOIRLab.
notes: CTIO filter pool numerical curves are hosted on NOIRLab CTIO science pages without an explicit open redistribution grant.
